title: Private plane in Davao Sur crash report lands safely in Butuan

blocks.text: DAVAO CITY – The plane, allegedly carrying six foreigners, that was initially reported to have crashed in Sta. Cruz, Davao del Sur, Tuesday morning, had landed safely in Butuan City, a top Office of Civil Defense (OCD) official in Region 11 said. Ednar Dayanghirang, OCD-11 director, described the reported crash of the small plane as “fake news.” He said the plane landed safely at the Bancasi Airport in Butuan City shortly past 12 p.m., citing official information from the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP).
